pages.text:
A hall of Gas Centrifuges that enriches UF₆.
# Building it
- A floor of Centrifuge Cascade Casings, 3 to 7 blocks each way, with the controller in an edge of it (not a corner), facing out.
- Gas Centrifuges (two blocks tall) standing on the floor, anywhere but over the controller, where its control panel stands. Put them in rows: each row gets its header pipes.
- The two layers over the floor otherwise open (torches and the like are fine).
Ports go on the floor's outer faces: Input (feed), Output (product), Tails, and Energy.

# Separative work
Each centrifuge does 0.02 SWU a tick and uses 40 FE/t. Set the target (1% to 20%) and the tails (0.1% to 0.5%, 0.25% by default) in its GUI. Each mB of product costs separative work by the real formula, so richer product and leaner tails cost more:
- 3%: 6.0 mB of natural feed and 3.8 SWU.
- 5%: 10.3 mB and 7.9 SWU.
- 20%: 42.8 mB and 41.6 SWU.
The rest of the feed leaves as tails, Depleted Uranium Hexafluoride.

# Running it
- Feed may be any UF₆ poorer than the target and richer than the tails, so 5% can be fed back to reach 20%.
- After changing the target or tails, drain the old product or tails first: it won't mix assays.
- Redstone control can stop it. While it runs its centrifuges' bands spin and the hall hums.
